 Order

NC: 2023:KHC:45869 (C) Issue a writ in nature of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction and direct respondents no.1 and 2 to allot developed land in terms of Government Order dated 23.02.2021 (Annexure-F) in lieu of monetary compensation after securing veracity report from respondent no.3 about veracity of grant of land in question in favour of petitioners'
family and etc.
2.

Sri R. Srinivasa Gowda, learned counsel for petitioners submitted that petitioners were owners of land measuring 1 Acre 10 guntas in bearing Sy.no.127 of Cheelur Village, Maralavadi Hobli,
Harohalli Taluk, acquired by respondent no.2 for formation of industrial area.

It was further submitted that after process of acquisition was completed, petitioners made representation to Mrs. Nagarasamma vs State Of Karnataka on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190788035/
2 respondents for granting developed land in lieu of compensation under Section 29(2) of Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, (for short 'KIAD Act') as per Government Order dated 23.02.2021.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was further submitted that without granting opportunity to petitioners to avail benefit of grant of developed land, passing General Award was unjustified and sought for quashing General Award.

On other hand, Sri Manjunath V. Rayappa, learned AGA appearing for respondents no.1 and 3 and Sri Ramakrishna C., learned counsel for respondent no.2 submit that in case petitioners'
representation is pending, same would be considered in accordance with law within reasonable time.
5.
Heard learned counsel and perused writ petition records.
6. From above, failure of respondents to offer opportunity to petitioners to avail benefit under Government Order dated 23.02.2021 and passing of General Award would be unsustainable.

Hence, impugned General Award dated 02.09.2021 at Annexure-A stands quashed insofar as petitioners' land i.e. Sy.no.127, measuring 1 Acre 10 guntas of Cheelur Village, Maralavadi Hobli,
Harohalli Taluk.

Respondent no.2 is directed to consider petitioners' representation at Annexure-H for grant of developed land in lieu of compensation as per Government Order dated 23.02.2021 at Annexure-F,
in accordance with law within period NC: 2023:KHC:45869 of three months from date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
It is clarified that issuance of direction to consider shall not be construed as positive direction to grant relief as sought for in representation, but only for consideration on own merits.
With above observation, writ petition stands disposed of.
